corrections.reason: The printed glyph at the end of ከነዚህ is the 6th-order ህ (with the left-indented stem), forming the standard Amharic demonstrative ከነዚህ.
The word translating Ge'ez ጠቢብ is Amharic ብልህ ('wise/clever') with 6th-order ህ, which is clearly visible in the column image.
In Mark 12:38, the Ge'ez plural imperative matching ዑቁ ('beware') and the Amharic gloss ተለዩም ('and separate yourselves') is ወተገኃሡ (2nd-order ሡ), with the right-side vowel stroke visible on the glyph.
The plural of ድኃ is ድኆች ('the poor/widows'), and the 7th-order ring of ኆ in የድኆችን is clearly printed in the image.
